paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between context consistency and context inconsistency under the prefix-constrained decoding Setting. The x-aixs denotes the number of tokens for the gold prefix.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the BLEU scores for two different decoding settings—context consistency (wait-1) and context inconsistency (wait-9)—as a function of the length of the gold prefix, under prefix-constrained decoding. The x-axis, labeled "the length of gold prefix," ranges from 0 to 20 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," ranges from 23 to 29 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line with circular markers represents "Consistency: wait-1," starting at approximately 24.5 BLEU at a prefix length of 0, dropping to around 23.5 at length 1, then gradually increasing to about 28.5 at length 20. The red solid line with square markers represents "Inconsistency: wait-9," starting at approximately 25.0 BLEU at length 0, fluctuating between 25.0 and 26.0 up to length 20, with minor peaks and troughs but remaining relatively stable overall. The blue line shows a clear upward trend, while the red line remains largely flat with slight variations.
